name: reach-rules-through-a-function-value
description: A call through a variable whose value is a known function reaches what a direct call of that function reaches, for each rule below: a value formatted through a variable holding a formatting function keeps the String method the format verb calls, and a method a string names in a call through a variable holding a function outside the analyzed program is kept. A call through a variable holding a method expression reads its first argument as the receiver and the rest as the method's parameters, so a value formatted through a logger method expression, directly or through a wrapper, keeps its String method, and a method a string names through reflect.Value.MethodByName held that way is kept. A method no string names is reported. A variable that can hold two lookups makes both, whichever is written first, so a field one of them names is kept.
